text:
Lina: put up a draft relnote for the embeddings streaming deprecation and the new Go migration pattern: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620
Pete: reading it now. we should call out the Dedicated timeout regression as a Known Issue and include an immediate workaround. customers will hit this during our rollout.
Ravi: agreed. suggested text: 'Known issue: some pre-0.9 Dedicated runtimes may experience streaming timeouts for large batches. Workaround: set REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH=1 or switch to non-streaming model variants until runtime upgrade.' keep it short.
Lina: that reads well. also need a tiny before/after Go snippet for the migration guide (old + new). keep examples minimal for the UI card.
Pete: paste the snippets inline (<=8 lines). we'll reference them from the migration page.
Lina: ```go
// old
resp, err := client.Embeddings().Stream(ctx, input)
// new
client.Embeddings().Generate(ctx, input, func(chunk EmbeddingChunk){
  fmt.Println(chunk.Vector[:2])
})
```
Ravi: add a short note: 'Note: streaming embeddings token counting in analytics is under investigation; analytics v2 will reconcile counts.'
Lina: done. removed any mention of internal flags.
ci-bot: docs/pr-4620: linkcheck failed -> /docs/sdk/go#migrate-embeds anchor missing
Pete: looks like the Go page anchor changed in another PR. I'll add a redirect and fix the anchor to match the migration link.
Ravi: I'll update the relnotes PR once the link is fixed so staging passes. also added a one-line bold 'breaking' header so users notice the deprecation quickly.
Lina: added the marketing blurb to the announcement draft as requested by product.
Pete: I trimmed the snippets and fixed trailing whitespace; pushed. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: pushed anchor redirect to _redirects.yaml and updated the Go page id. left a note in the PR thread explaining the rename. :shipit:
ci-bot: re-run checks: all green. build passed.
Lina: merging in 5 if no blockers. @Pete @Ravi please ack.
Pete: ack.
Ravi: ack from my side.
Lina: merged. I'll follow up with a short support FAQ and an internal SE note about Dedicated upgrade windows. closing thread.
